data.one_liner: Annotations for riverpod_generator to enable code generation
data.what_it_does: Provides annotations used by riverpod_generator to generate Riverpod providers. It contains only annotation classes and no runtime logic.
use_when: You are using riverpod_generator for code generation
You want to keep provider definitions concise and type-safe
avoid_when: You are not using riverpod_generator or prefer manual provider definitions
data.setup_notes: Add riverpod_annotation and riverpod_generator to dev_dependencies and run build_runner
